title: Mt Hood Center
specs: Located on 18-acre campus in Boring, Oregon, 20-30 minutes from Portland
Historic restored facility with modern amenities
Multiple flexible venues including Ballroom, Greenhouse, Café, Meadow, Conference rooms
Event insurance required: $1,000,000 general liability and $300,000 premises damage coverage
If alcohol is served, insurance must include host liquor liability
Ballroom seats up to 425 banquet guests
Kids Space 1 capacity 50 guests; Kids Space 2 combined capacity 75 guests
Café Event Space capacity up to 75 seated guests

blurb: Mt Hood Center offers multiple event spaces including a large Ballroom, a whimsical Kids Space, a rustic Café, and versatile studios. Guests can host weddings, corporate events, parties, and workshops with amenities like heating, cooling, Wi-Fi, prep areas, and parking. The center supports events from intimate gatherings to large celebrations with full staff support and flexible layouts.
extraNote: 10% discount on space rental with proof of service from bride or groom · 10% discount on space rental with proof of service from couple for Kids Space · Payment in full and signed contract required to secure event date · Events can be rescheduled or deposits used towards another event if canceled
